text: Inline flight and hotel compare boards now render directly in chat — compare options and pick one without leaving the conversation.
Free-tier flight search now falls back gracefully to public fare sources when consolidator credentials aren't present, so a search always returns results.

A security regression suite covering tenant isolation, auth, tier enforcement, output escaping and SSRF now gates every production deploy. Two vulnerability classes were found and fixed along the way.
Advisors can set commission rates on individual option choices straight from the in-chat proposal, with values that survive a trip rebuild.
Added geocoding and place search — resolve location names to coordinates and find restaurants, attractions and hotels, with results cached globally.
The in-chat proposal now shows per-segment flight detail: route, carrier, times, layovers, cabin, confirmation number and price.
Added a day-by-day timeline and a full budget breakdown to the in-chat proposal.
Shipped a batch of in-chat proposal features: action items, packing list, agency branding, per-day highlights, hero image, and calendar (.ics) export.
Advisors can now edit trip text — traveler summary, day notes, budget notes — directly inside the in-chat proposal, with edits gated to advisors.
Per-user credential vault: advisors store their own supplier logins, and tools activate automatically based on what's present.
Finalized the Free / Pro / Agency tier model, with the tool catalog locked per session at connect time.
